description: America's best-selling cargo eBike has been reimagined with an all-new design. Introducing the XPedition 2.0, Lectric’s most advanced cargo carrier yet. Engineered to conquer even the steepest hills and carry up to 450 lbs of load, this eBike is versatile enough for a wide range of riders. Now upgraded with a torque sensor to deliver an unparalleled pedal assist experience, an 8-speed Shimano shifter, 1,310W peak motor, color LCD display, and a longer frame with updated tubing. Enjoy a smoother ride with a front suspension fork, and travel farther with up to 35Ah of battery life. Paired with a line of tailor-made accessories to elevate your riding experience!

components.description: The front wheel features a quick-release Thru Axle wheel attachment system for tool-free installation. This feature ensures a straight wheel, consistent brake rotor alignment, and handling stability.
Ultimate stopping power with hydraulic mineral oil brakes paired with 180mm rotors (2.2mm thick) offers peace of mind in wet or dry conditions.
11-32 tooth, 8-geared freewheel
A KMC Z8 steel chain paired with an idler pulley offers consistent tension and secure performance throughout your ride.
Forged aluminum, 52-tooth chainring is the perfect ratio for effortless 20-inch wheel pedaling.
Shimano Altus derailleur

Two removable 48V, 17.5Ah (combined 35Ah, 1680Wh) lithium-ion batteries certified to UL 2271 makes for a clean design while powering your ride for up to 170 miles on a single charge.** The XPedition is also certified to UL 2849.†

An external battery allows riders to charge the eBike without removing the battery. The XPedition comes standard with a 2amp charger for 7-9 hour charging per battery but a 5amp Fast Charger can be purchased separately to speed up charging by 250%.
A 750W rear hub-motor (1310W Peak) with 85Nm of torque delivers power and speed quicker than ever before.
24 amp externally mounted controller is IP-65 rated and potted for weather proofing and thermal management.
A backlit color LCD display with a USB-C port provides trip and battery intelligence on the go. IP-65 rated electrical components ensure greater water and dust resistance.
Polypropolene Fenders protect you and your ride from debris. The rear fender features an integrated side-pane wheel shroud to shield cargo and passengers from the eBikes rotating components.

The Courier 50 is a custom dual-spring suspension fork with up to 50mm of travel that provides shock absorption for a smooth and comfortable ride. Independent pre-load adjustments in each fork leg allow you to tailor each ride to your preference based on payload capacity and weight distribution.
Ergonomic lock-on grips add comfort so you can ride longer. The plastic sleeve inside helps lock the grips into place and also allows the grips to be easily removed.

A sturdy dual-leg kickstand with a 15+ inch spread located near the bottom bracket ensures the most balanced position for easy loading***. Pushing forward allows you to start riding without having to manually put the kickstand up with precious cargo.
An integrated safety system, featuring a headlamp and a brake-activated rear light powered by the internal battery allows you to be seen at any time of day.

Alert drivers, riders, and people nearby by indicating which direction you are headed with our new turn signals. Simply use the left or right arrows on the display control pad to trigger a blinking cadence on one side of the rear light.
Quick-release pedals easily detach from the bike for compact transport.

A long rear rack integrated into the bike frame holds up to 300lbs and features a specially designed bar for mounting various accessory combinations. The rear rack also has 2 bulit-in mounting windows to easily install childrens seats & more.
A custom-designed saddle compliments a sporty look while adding comfort so you can ride longer.
An adjustable and removable seat post with two different expansion points allows riders to reach a wide range of heights while maintaining comfort and stability.

A unique torque sensor combined with PWR+ technology, or Pedal Assist Wattage Regulation+, helps to manage power output based on the rider’s pedaling effort. With this technology, riders can reach higher speeds easily and with more control than ever before.
thumb-triggered handlebar shifter
Easily adjustable handlebar stem riser includes a quick-release lever to comfortably adjust your handlebar reach to your liking; bring your handlebars toward you or push them further back.
An ergonomic below-the-bar trigger throttle on the left hand side is easily engaged with your thumb while simultaneously eliminating joint fatigue.
Puncture-resistant 20” x 2.5” street tires make for a smoother ride with ease of control at hand. Slime is installed to prevent flat tires- at no additional cost.

Lectric's new Pedal Assist Wattage Regulation+ (PWR+) programming allows for an improved Pedal Assist experience by assisting the rider up to a certain power level for each PAS setting. Learn more about PWR here.
